decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche far from the core, with long naval procurement cycles, so its value is still uncertain; carrying a line already developed costs little, which makes holding the option worthwhile despite thin website presence.
The explosion-proof line builds on the core business, kept its own page and gained an LED replacement kit, which signals that the option is resolving favorably and the firm is investing further.

The relaunched designer task light is close to the core and cheap to keep, but it is a mature design among several overlapping office products, so it is moderately exposed if resources are redirected.
The pendant office luminaire is a recent, low-cost addition close to the established offer, and its prospects are still unresolved, so holding the option is justified.
The premium pendant line has several models, which shows commitment, and it is close to the core, so keeping it is cheap while market response is still emerging.
